messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — found a weird quota split when TS/Go clients receive multiple route hints from the routing policy. repro below.

Alex: repro steps: 1) send request hitting policy that returns two compatible variants, 2) runtime attaches two `x-route-hint` headers, 3) SDKs surface quota attribution as 100% to the first hint in the console.

Alex: example headers we saw:
```http
x-route-hint: model=redwood-13b;region=us-west;quota=kb_777
x-route-hint: model=redwood-13b-q;region=eu;quota=kb_888
```

Maria: thanks — do we think SDKs are collapsing the header list into a single value?

Sam: likely. Go client uses `Header.Get` in a couple places (returns first). TS client uses `headers.get('x-route-hint')` too. both would drop extras.

Jess: console/telemetry side also shows a single quota bucket in the per-route breakdown which makes it look like traffic got fully charged to us-west. not ideal.

Ryan: CI-bot triggered a test failure on quota e2e yesterday that matched this pattern. it masked multi-variant fallback traffic as a single bucket which breaks reserved capacity reports.

Maria: minimal proposal: surface all `x-route-hint` values in SDKs as arrays and pass through them in telemetry payload. UI can aggregate or show split.

Sam: agree. but note backwards compat: a lot of customers expect `sdk.routeHint` string today. we should keep a compatibility field and add `routeHints[]`.

Alex: can we do a phased change: TS/Go add `routeHints` array and keep `routeHint` string as the first hint (for compat). server and console start ingesting arrays if present. rollout flag for 2 weeks.

Jess: UI UX: show primary hint with small chevron to expand list. for quota dashboard, show both aggregated view and per-hint breakdown.

Maria: telemetry schema change: add `route_hints` (array of strings) and keep `route_hint` (string). we need to bump schema version and add migration notes for offline consumers.

Sam: quick code snippet for TS clients (rough):
```ts
const routeHintsHeader = response.headers.getAll ? response.headers.getAll('x-route-hint') : (response.headers.get('x-route-hint')|| '').split(',');
const routeHints = routeHintsHeader.filter(Boolean).map(h => h.trim());
// set sdk.response.routeHints = routeHints; sdk.response.routeHint = routeHints[0] || null;
```

Alex: thanks. Ryan — can you wire a small e2e that asserts telemetry contains the array when server returns two hints? put behind feature flag.

Ryan: on it. I'll add test and an incident check to ensure console aggregation hasn't regressed.

Maria: timeline? can we aim for PRs by EOD tomorrow and a staged rollout early next week?

Sam: should be doable for TS; Go needs a tiny refactor but ok.

Jess: I'll design the expanded UI affordance today and drop screenshots in this thread. :eyes: 

CI-bot: created ticket INF-4821 for SDK array passthrough + INF-4822 for console ingestion. links: https://tracker.internal/INF-4821 https://tracker.internal/INF-4822

Alex: awesome. thanks all — this should stop misleading quota reports and make routing telemetry more accurate.

Maria: follow-ups: update docs for header semantics, add note to migration guide, communicate in release notes.

Sam: noted. will include sample snippets and a changelog entry.

Jess: will coordinate with marketing if we want customer-facing notice. otherwise internal only.

Alex: internal only for now. we'll escalate if customers ask. :thumbsup:
